latest_release.body:
This release of the Official Models targets [TensorFlow 2.20.0](https://github.com/tensorflow/tensorflow/releases/tag/v2.20.0)
Note that Research/tutorial/sample models have been removed.

Release branch is: https://github.com/tensorflow/models/tree/r2.20.0
